name: indahl-ccr
description: Custody chain receipts for agent work. A hash-chained record in .ccr/ of every prompt, tool call, denied call, read and write, with approvals and releases bound to the hashes they cover. Release reads SAME, MOVED, CHANGED, CANNOT_TELL or GAP and lists shipped lines no approval covered. Attribution is shown from the record and cause is left to a named judge. Nothing is sent outside your project.
